Call Maria Garcia on the phone number on file, and if the account is unchanged, approve paying the account ending 7771 on file; never pay the account in the email.

events.title: Approval: instant advance for Andrea Cruz on Metal testnet
lines: Andrea Cruz opted in to instant advances on 2026-10-02 through the verified portal, to 0xA3aE…31DF. Contoso Health caps an advance at USD 50.00.
Approval requested: advance 50.00 USDZ from Contoso Health's Metal account 0xd97e…b34B to Andrea Cruz. Bound to SHA-256 23d1d9450de5…
Approved by ops-lead@platform.example (scripted approver).
Mandate on Contoso Health's Metal account, enforced on chain: pays only Andrea Cruz, at most 50.00 USDZ per payment and 50.00 USDZ in total (spent 0.00 USDZ).
Probe, bypassing our policy code: 50.00 USDZ to 0x0000…dEaD, an address not on the mandate. Metal refused, nothing sent: mandate_payee_not_listed (the payee is not one the mandate allows)
Probe, bypassing our policy code: 50.01 USDZ to Andrea Cruz, one cent over the cap. Metal refused, nothing sent: mandate_cap_exceeded (the amount is above the mandate's per-payment cap)
Paid 50.00 USDZ to Andrea Cruz on Metal testnet: transaction 0x265f…0265 https://testnet.metalntwx.com/tx/0x265f023a9aeebf2913ec893ab92c085b892dcafab53058a69b8632dd22210265
Same pull again, same payment id: already paid, nothing sent.
Probe, bypassing our policy code: another 50.00 USDZ to Andrea Cruz under a new payment id. Metal refused, nothing sent: mandate_budget_spent (the amount would take the mandate past its budget)
Verified from the chain alone (mandate verify): yes, 1 payment under this mandate.
The remaining PHP 256,896.77 goes in the next Philippine LOCAL window; Andrea Cruz is told now.
